cues.text: Across 5 LLM test seeds, mean MCC was 0.6262 without bounds, with a sample standard deviation of 0.1131.
With bounds, the mean was 0.5951, with a smaller standard deviation of 0.0413.
So bounds reduced variation, but the mean was also lower.
The table shows only 1 LHS test seed.
There are also 20 LHS validation seeds.
These add no repeated test result.
We therefore cannot treat this as a matched repeated-test comparison between LLM and LHS.
